instructions.name: approve
docs: A guardian approves. Reaching the threshold sets `eta`.

instructions.name: cancel_withdrawal
docs: Owner, any guardian or the AI cancels a pending withdrawal. Allowed while frozen.

instructions.name: close_proposal
docs: Anyone closes a dead (stale or expired) proposal and refunds its rent.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Anyone moves tokens into the vault. Allowed while frozen.

accounts.name: from
docs: Source account. The token program enforces that `depositor` is its owner or delegate.

instructions.name: emergency_sweep
docs: Any guardian sweeps the whole balance to the safe address. Allowed while frozen.

accounts.name: guardian
docs: Pays for the safe ATA if it doesn't exist yet.

accounts.name: safe_token
docs: `safe_address` (INV-9, audit A6). It is created idempotently in the handler,
so a missing safe ATA can never block a rescue. The ATA program verifies
owner and mint for an existing account.

instructions.name: execute_proposal
docs: Anyone executes a proposal past its `eta`.

accounts.name: executor
docs: Pays for a new TrustedAddress (AddTrusted) and gets RemoveTrusted refunds.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: `dup`: the proposer usually executes their own proposal, so this is often
the same account as `executor` (audit F-1). It only ever receives lamports,
so aliasing is safe.

accounts.name: trusted
docs: checks that it's exactly PDA `["trusted", vault, action.trusted_wallet()]`.

instructions.name: execute_withdrawal
docs: Anyone executes a matured withdrawal with a matching owner epoch.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Pinned by `has_one = destination`. The mint is re-checked here (INV-9).

instructions.name: freeze
docs: Owner, any guardian or the AI freezes the vault.

instructions.name: initialize_vault
docs: Creates a vault and its token account. The creator becomes the owner.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Pays rent and becomes the first owner.

accounts.name: mint
docs: v1: classic SPL Token mints only (PROGRAM-SPEC §1, Token-2022 extensions break INV-1).
Together with the `token_program` address check, every Token-2022 combination
fails with `UnsupportedMint` (CR-INIT-2).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Must come before `vault_token`. Anchor checks constraints in field order,
so a Token-2022 program fails here with `UnsupportedMint` rather than as a
generic address mismatch on the ATA (CR-INIT-2).

accounts.name: vault_token
docs: ATA(vault, mint) for classic SPL Token. It isn't created with `init`,
because anyone can create an ATA permissionlessly, and a third party
pre-creating it would then block the vault forever (CR-INIT-1). The handler
calls ATA `create_idempotent` after every check passes. For an existing
account, the ATA program verifies the owner (vault) and mint.

instructions.name: propose
docs: Any guardian proposes a governance action (auto-approves their own bit).

accounts.name: guardian
docs: Pays the Proposal rent and gets it back on execute or veto.

instructions.name: request_withdrawal
docs: Owner requests a delayed withdrawal (cancellable until `executes_at`).

accounts.name: owner
docs: Pays the Withdrawal rent and gets it back on execute or cancel.

accounts.name: withdrawal
docs: Ids come from the vault counter and are never reused (INV-12, E2).

instructions.name: veto
docs: Any guardian vetoes a vetoable proposal (but not their own removal).

instructions.name: withdraw_instant
docs: Owner spends within the rolling 24h allowance.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Only the current owner. Guardians and the AI are rejected (INV-5).

instructions.name: withdraw_trusted
docs: Owner sends any amount to an active trusted wallet.

accounts.name: trusted
docs: It is unchecked so that a missing record returns `NotTrusted`
rather than a generic framework error. The handler verifies the owner and discriminator.

errors.msg: Signer is not the vault owner

errors.name: NotGuardian
errors.msg: Signer is not a guardian of this vault

errors.name: NotAuthorizedRole
errors.msg: Signer's role is not allowed to perform this action

errors.name: OverDailyLimit
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the remaining daily allowance

errors.name: NotTrusted
errors.msg: Destination is not a trusted address

errors.name: TrustedNotActive
errors.msg: Trusted address is not active yet

errors.name: TooEarly
errors.msg: Too early: the delay has not elapsed

errors.name: StaleOwnerEpoch
errors.msg: Withdrawal was requested by a previous owner key

errors.name: StaleGuardianEpoch
errors.msg: Proposal was created under a previous guardian set

errors.name: ThresholdNotMet
errors.msg: Guardian threshold not met

errors.name: AlreadyApproved
errors.msg: This guardian has already approved

errors.name: InvalidThreshold
errors.msg: Threshold must be between 1 and the number of guardians

errors.name: DuplicateGuardian
errors.msg: Duplicate guardian

errors.name: RoleOverlap

errors.name: DelayOutOfBounds
errors.msg: Delay is outside the allowed bounds

errors.name: NotStricter
errors.msg: Change must be stricter than the current setting

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: Token account mint does not match the vault mint

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.msg: Insufficient funds in the vault

errors.name: TooManyTrusted

errors.name: NotVetoable
errors.msg: This proposal cannot be vetoed

errors.name: CannotVetoOwnRemoval

errors.name: InvalidGuardianCount
errors.msg: A vault needs between 1 and 5 guardians

errors.name: InvalidGuardian

errors.name: InvalidSafeAddress

errors.name: UnsupportedMint

errors.name: MathOverflow

errors.name: InvalidAmount

errors.name: InvalidDestination

errors.name: AlreadyTrusted
errors.msg: This wallet is already trusted

errors.name: InvalidTrustedWallet
errors.msg: Trusted wallet is invalid

errors.name: TrustedAccountMismatch

errors.name: ProposalExpired
errors.msg: Proposal expired before reaching its threshold

errors.name: ProposalStillLive
errors.msg: Proposal is still live and cannot be closed

types.name: GovAction
docs: A guardian-threshold change to the vault.

types.name: Proposal
docs: A governance proposal. PDA: `["proposal", vault, id_le]`. Closed on execute or veto.

fields.name: approvals
docs: Bitmap indexed by guardian slot (INV-8).

fields.name: guardian_epoch
docs: `vault.guardian_epoch` at creation (INV-7).

fields.name: eta
docs: 0 until the threshold is reached, then `now + timelock`. Set once (INV-3, C7).

types.name: Role
docs: Which role performed a protective action (reported in events).

types.name: Vault
docs: A self-custodial savings vault. PDA: `["vault", creator, vault_id_le]`.
Seeds use `creator` (immutable), never `owner` (rotatable).

fields.name: owner_epoch
docs: Bumped on owner rotation. Pending withdrawals must match it (INV-6).

fields.name: guardians
docs: Unused slots are `Pubkey::default()`.

fields.name: guardian_epoch
docs: Bumped whenever the guardian set or threshold changes (INV-7).

fields.name: ai_guardian
docs: `Pubkey::default()` means no AI guardian.

fields.name: safe_address
docs: Wallet that receives an emergency sweep (its ATA for `mint`).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields, so we never need a realloc.

types.name: VaultInitialized
docs: Program events (PROGRAM-SPEC §6). Sentinel subscribes to these.

types.name: Withdrawal
docs: A pending delayed withdrawal. PDA: `["withdrawal", vault, id_le]`.
It exists only while pending. Execute or cancel closes it.

fields.name: destination
docs: Destination **token account** (mint checked at request and execute).

fields.name: owner_epoch
docs: `vault.owner_epoch` at request time (INV-6).

types.name: TrustedAddress
docs: A trusted destination wallet. PDA: `["trusted", vault, wallet]`.
Created only by an executed `AddTrusted` proposal.

constants.name: MAX_TRUSTED
docs: Trusted-address cap per vault.

constants.name: MIN_DELAY
docs: Timelock bounds, in seconds. 60 s is the minimum so the devnet demo can show a
full cycle. The UI defaults to 86,400.

constants.name: PROPOSAL_TTL
docs: A proposal must reach its threshold within this many seconds of creation.

constants.name: WINDOW_SECONDS
docs: Length of the instant-allowance window.
